comment: Object form of the manifest. "files" lists every prefab; "groups" declares settlements. A prefab joins a group with a top-level "group": "<name>". Grouped prefabs never spawn on their own.

village._doc: count = houses per village (at least 4; members with a door or a doorway are houses), plus a well for every 4 houses (members without one; the first in the middle), radius = how far they scatter from the centre, spacing = minimum gap between footprints, path = the block paths are paved with, pathWidth = [min, max] path width 1-3, apart = no other village (of any group) closer than this many blocks.

catacomb._doc: rooms = how many chambers, corridor = gap between rooms that the tunnel spans, spread = radius of chunks the dungeon claims.

desert_village._doc: The desert village (0.82422): same rules as the village, its paths grass (path 1). replace = block swaps for what it builds and its foundations (dirt -> sand). Members: prefabs with group desert_village.
